contract: ideas_first10 §3-#7 (검수 2026-10-07): Config.SpawnSpread.Tutorial = { StarvedThreshold 3, MinDist 10, MaxDist 18, Extra 3 }. A hunter = TutorialStep Tutorial.Steps.Quest (2) standing in Tutorial.GuideZone (SlimeMeadow). For the tutorial monster (Slime) a starved hunter (< 3 monsters within 30 studs) is chosen first and gets the point 10-18 studs away on the half circle facing the zone middle (12 tries); other starved players (< 2): a Rookie first, then the lowest level, then the fewest near, ring 18-28 (6 tries); King Slimes and other kinds keep the A7-1 rule. Each hunter in the meadow raises the Slime target by 3 (never above Count x MaxZoneMult = 24) through targetCount and cappedTargets; the bonus ends when the hunt ends (playersPerZone refreshes the hunters every pass).
limitations: Players, Util (Random seeded, scripted draws), the ground ray (always flat ground) and the monster count near a player are doubles; the real Studio check (first kill within 10 s after the trip) is game dev 1's. The season (Config.SeasonOn) follows the machine clock; the checks compare with Config's own MonsterTargets so they hold either way.
